notes: Cover Albums now uses a 90 percent rule: releases with at least 90 percent covers qualify automatically, and albums explicitly presented as cover albums may qualify below that threshold.
Restored cover-focused albums such as Cat Power's The Covers Record while keeping mixed full-concert releases such as Phish Halloween shows out of Cover Albums.
Rebuilt SoundTrail around one connected recording catalog so a recording can belong to more than one instrument without duplication.
Added per-instrument genre filters and genre-specific About sections describing the instrument's role and importance in each represented style.
Migrated the existing 60 accordion recordings and added starter recordings for Clarinet, Pedal Steel Guitar, Cello, Sitar, Double Bass, and Tabla.
Added support for localized Spotify URLs when handing tracks off to the Spotify app.
